howDoI.q: How do I make a flock of birds that stay in formation?
How do I keep a group of monsters in a V or other shape?
How do I make monsters fly a path and turn back?
How do I make flying monsters that do not hurt?
How do I make one monster in a group fly faster?
How do I make a group where some monsters are a different kind?

pages.head: Welcome
pages.html:
Welcome

Birds of a Feather is a Starter: a small game that shows a few Game-Maker ideas, with signs in the levels that say what you are looking at. It has two short levels and takes a couple of minutes to finish.

Play it first. Then open it in Game-Maker (Edit a copy on the home page keeps the original safe) and read the pages below, which say where each thing in the levels is made.

The keys

Left and Right walk. Space jumps. F2 shows your lives, hit points and score. Walk into the door at the end of a level to go on.

Five birds fly high over Kit in a V. Nothing in this game hurts you.

pages.head: Level 1: One Shape
pages.html:
Level 1: One Shape

The FIVE BIRDS KEEP ONE SHAPE sign stands near the start. Five green birds fly 14 blocks to the right, turn, and fly back again, over and over. Watch them: the V never changes.

The SAME PATH, SAME SPEED sign says why. Each bird has the same path and the same speed, and they all begin when the level loads, so none of them gets ahead of the others.

There are six coins, some over a small brick hill.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 1 is made

  • The shape. Open one.map in the map editor. Five monsters of one kind, the green bird, are placed in a V: two blocks apart across, one block lower each step toward the middle. Game-Maker has no flock. The shape is just where the birds were put.
  • The path. Open bird.mon in the monsters editor and pick the bird. Its Movement is Follows its path. The path goes 14 blocks to the right and then back to where it began. Every bird walks the same path from its own starting place.
  • The speed. Each corner of the path has a Speed (pixels per tick). All of this bird's corners say 2, so five birds with the same speed stay the same distance apart.
  • Friendly. The bird's picture in bird.mbl is not solid and takes no hit points, and its power is 110, so touching Kit neither hurts nor pops it.
  • Forever. Its Lives is Forever (indestructible), so the V is always there.
  • The signs. Each sign is a few ordinary blocks side by side, with the words drawn in their pictures.

pages.head: Level 2: Out of Step
pages.html:
Level 2: Out of Step

The GOLD BIRDS FLY FASTER sign stands near the start. The V begins just as before, but its two middle birds are gold.

The NOW THE SHAPE COMES APART sign says what you will see. The gold birds pull ahead on the way out, reach the turn first, and meet the green ones on the way back. The V stays a V only for a moment.

There are eight coins along the ground.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 2 is made

  • A second kind. The gold bird is its own monster in bird.mon, with its own pictures in bird.mbl. Its path is the same 14 blocks. Only its corners' Speed (pixels per tick) differs: 3 instead of 2.
  • Placed like the others. Open two.map. The same V of five monsters is placed, but the two middle ones are the gold kind.
  • Why it comes apart. A monster follows its path on its own. Nothing ties the birds together, so when one is faster it simply gets further along the path than the rest.
  • The exit. The last door links to the The End scene in bird.gam, which plays the ending.

pages.head: What it cannot do
pages.html:
What it cannot do

A flock here is just monsters on the same path, and that is all it is:

  • There is no real flocking. Birds do not keep their distance from each other, steer around things or follow a leader. The shape is only where the map put them.
  • A path has at most 10 corners, so a bird cannot fly anything wilder than that.
  • A bird cannot change its path because of Kit or the shape. Give it a different speed and it leaves the group for good.
  • A level holds at most 200 monsters and only about 50 are drawn at a time, so a big flock has to be small or spread out.
  • Two kinds of bird need two entries in the monster file, even if they look alike.

pages.head: Make it yours
pages.html:
Make it yours

Try one change at a time, and play after each:

  • Change the gold bird's speed to 2. The V holds again.
  • Make the path longer or give it a corner that goes down, and watch the whole V follow it.
  • Move one bird on the map. The V now has a gap or a bump, and it keeps it.
  • Add a second V on the map, a few blocks lower.

The home page's Starters tab has more small games like this one.
